title: The Scaling Window of Random $k$-SAT
summary: We prove a general upper bound for scaling windows of sparse monotone covering problems. From that, we deduce that for every fixed value $k\geq 3$, the window of random $k$-SAT is $O(n/\log n)$, improving the Friedgut-Bourgain bound of $O(n/\log\log n)$. We also show that random signed Not-All-Equal-$k$-SAT and hypergraph non-two-colourability (Property B) have windows of the same order.
